content.title: MAKNA UPACARA BATIMBANG DALAM TRADISI MASYARAKAT SUKU BANJAR KUALA TUNGKAL, PROVINSI JAMBI
Jurnal Online Mahasiswa (JOM) Bidang Keguruan dan Ilmu Pendidikan
ISLAMIC VALUE IN MELAYU’S BIMBANG TRADITION

results:
The search turned up several sources on the Bimbang tradition, though none defines "Bimbang Balai" directly.

- **South Bengkulu:** A study of Jeranglah Village in Manna District examines how the Bimbang Balai custom is carried out and what has caused it to shift. It uses historical and anthropological methods, with interviews and questionnaires. The problems raised in this study are how the implementation process of Bimbang Balai Custom and what causes a shift in the Bimbang Balai Custom.
- **Bengkulu Malay tradition:** A separate paper describes Bimbang as a ceremony that marks moments such as inaugurations, weddings, and the installation of traditional leaders, and it links the tradition to the life cycle. Bimbang is a tradition of the Bengkulu Malay community in the form of holding traditional ceremonies to celebrate various moments such as inauguration, marriage, and the appointment of traditional heads.
- **Banjar in Kuala Tungkal, Jambi:** This is a different ritual, called batimbang, performed for children born in the Safar month, which is considered unlucky. It involves weighing the child as a protective rite. The child must be weighed as a form of ritual refusing reinforcement and recovery from unlucky circumstances.

The results don't contain detailed ceremony steps for Bimbang Balai specifically. The Jeranglah study (repository.unsri.ac.id/15312) is the most direct match for your query.

results:
The search turned up no detailed step-by-step account of the Bimbang Balai procession itself, but it did surface related material on Serawai weddings in South Bengkulu.

- **Meaning:** One source says Bimbang means doubt. The doubt meant is whether the wedding will run smoothly and whether the future household will go well.
- **Link to dance:** A member of the Seluma regency customary council (BMA) says Tari Pisau Dua is usually performed at the Bimbang Adat (wedding) event. That dance comes from the Serawai people of Seluma.
- **Location and documentation:** A 2018 Sriwijaya University undergraduate thesis examines the shift in the Bimbang Balai custom in Desa Jerangalah, Kecamatan Manna, Bengkulu Selatan, from 1990 to 2017 (PERGESERAN ADAT BIMBANG BALAI DI DESA JERANGLAH KECAMATAN MANNA KABUPATEN BENGKULU SELATAN PADA TAHUN 1990-2017). The search showed only the record, not the full text.
- **Wedding music and dance:** A study of Kelintang Manna music says it accompanies the Andun dance in Serawai wedding ceremonies, creating a calm and sacred atmosphere. Another article on South Bengkulu weddings describes communal dancing by unmarried men and women, known as selawanan.

For the actual sequence of Bimbang Balai rites, the thesis and the Seluma BMA would be the best next sources.

content.text:
**Jawaban singkat:** Bimbang Bebalai (ditulis "Bimbang Balai" di sumber yang saya temukan) adalah upacara adat pernikahan di Bengkulu Selatan. Upacara ini berasal dari suku Serawai.

Hasil pencarian tidak menyebut suku itu secara langsung, jadi bagian ini adalah kesimpulan saya dari beberapa petunjuk:
- Sebuah skripsi Universitas Sriwijaya membahas pergeseran adat Bimbang Balai di Desa Jerangalah, Kecamatan Manna, Bengkulu Selatan, pada 1990–2017. Hanya catatan skripsinya yang tampil di hasil pencarian, bukan isi lengkapnya.
- Manna adalah wilayah suku Serawai. Dugaan ini berasal dari pengetahuan saya, bukan dari halaman yang saya buka.
- Seorang anggota dewan adat (BMA) Seluma mengatakan Tari Pisau Dua biasa dibawakan pada acara Bimbang Adat (pernikahan). Tarian itu berasal dari masyarakat Serawai di Seluma.
- Sebuah makalah menyebut "bimbang" sebagai tradisi adat Melayu Bengkulu untuk merayakan momen seperti pernikahan, pelantikan, dan pengangkatan kepala adat.

Saya tidak menemukan sumber yang menyebut "Bimbang Bebalai" persis dengan ejaan itu, atau yang menyatakan "Serawai" langsung di samping nama upacaranya. Urutan ritual Bimbang Balai juga tidak saya temukan.

Sumber:
- [Repositori Universitas Sriwijaya – Pergeseran Adat Bimbang Balai, Jerangalah, Manna](https://repository.unsri.ac.id/15312/)
- [Islamic Value in Melayu's Bimbang Tradition](https://proceedings.radenfatah.ac.id/index.php/isah/article/view/504)
- [Jurnal ISI Padangpanjang – Lagalaga](https://journal.isi-padangpanjang.ac.id/index.php/Lagalaga/article/download/852/539)
- [Jurnal UNP Sendratasik](https://ejournal.unp.ac.id/index.php/sendratasik/article/download/114479/105532)
